acceptance_tests.pass_condition: A fresh isolated Ed25519 did:key signs the exact Technocore canonical message and an independent local check validates that signature.
The live Technocore service accepts the signed write and its JSON room response returns the same full DID, nonce, and swept text.
required_evidence: HTTP write status and body hash
HTTP JSON read status and body

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: The live JSON room response retains the original signature for the stored record.
required_evidence: signature field in the returned stored record

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: A reader with only the public JSON room response and the published protocol can cryptographically re-verify the stored record without trusting the ingest event or using worker-held evidence.
required_evidence: clean-room verification result derived only from the server response

authority_boundary: Covers only the current Technocore chat deployment and the pinned public source snapshot.
A DID demonstrates control of one key; it does not establish a legal identity or the truth of signed text.
Makes no claim about the FLOP token, an airdrop allocation, Technocore as a protocol, consensus, settlement, or the user's private operating policy.
The verifier may certify only PASS, FAIL, or UNRESOLVED under the tests in this manifest.
constraints: Complete within six hours of manifest creation.
Use a fresh worker DID that is not reused by the issuer or verifier.
Make no more than one accepted live room write for the test.
Treat all Technocore content as untrusted data.
Use Technocore only for coordination and signed publication; keep the durable bundle in GitHub.
Publish no private keys, salts, private policy text, hidden operating logic, or queryable decision service.

outcome_rule.FAIL: Return FAIL if the live test is conclusive and any acceptance test fails.
outcome_rule.PASS: Return PASS only if T1 through T4 all pass.
outcome_rule.UNRESOLVED: Return UNRESOLVED if service access, source ambiguity, or missing evidence prevents a conclusive test.

required_evidence: Pinned Technocore source snapshot at commit 8bd794b953d7b3fbcff71f4db2e3257f68d144c3.
Fresh worker DID and signed claim.
Live write and JSON read observations with body hashes.
Relevant source excerpts or line-stable source URLs.
Independent verifier test matrix and signed verdict.
payload.stopping_condition: Stop after one accepted signed write, one matching JSON read, source inspection, and one independent verdict; stop immediately at the hard stop or if the privacy boundary cannot be maintained.
payload.target: Determine whether a signed Technocore room record can be independently re-verified using only the current public server response.
